remaining.summary: Persistence was exercised with synthetic results and release smoke checks. No live provider generation or manual re-open of a customer's paid output was used.

resolution.summary: Generated Director media registers after its bytes are durable and repairs existing missing browser sources from the same account/project-owned result, preserving IDs and avoiding reinstatement of removed assets. Ready ElevenLabs jobs automatically cache in browser storage independent of the Director tab; explicit Import to Assets adds new audio to project membership, and existing audio assets can recover their local source. Agent-generated images retain the paired canonical artifact archive and receive a local browser copy. Synthetic re-open/isolation/result tests passed, the production build passed, and 998de6144 was deployed with verified artifact, authenticated smoke, and native/WASM session-policy compatibility.
